Company index · data as of 2026-10-15

AI data companies

Public research on 39 AI data organizations: business model, revenue, funding, valuation and paid work routes, each with dated sources.

Coverage is a selected market study of 39 organizations, not an exhaustive census. Large firms not yet profiled include Uber AI Solutions, TELUS Digital, CloudFactory, SuperAnnotate, Encord, Defined.ai, LXT and Welocalize.

Open the interactive index

  • A.Team · Managed AI & data services

    Builds simulation environments and datasets that train safer, more capable AI agents.
  • AfterQuery · Expert data & evaluation
    AfterQuery builds expert-generated datasets and environments for frontier-model training. Its enterprise team also develops custom evaluations and deploys systems on a company’s own data.
